Product descriptions

Mass Yield presents Inzane in the Membrane, a premium 1g sativa pre-roll designed to energize and inspire. This expertly crafted flower pre-roll delivers an uplifting cerebral experience perfect for daytime activities, creative pursuits, or social gatherings. As a sativa-dominant strain, Inzane in the Membrane offers focused, euphoric effects that enhance productivity while keeping your mind clear and engaged. The pre-roll format provides convenient, ready-to-enjoy consumption with no grinding or rolling required. Mass Yield's commitment to quality ensures a smooth, flavorful smoke with every session. Whether you're looking to boost creativity, stay motivated, or simply elevate your day, this 1g pre-roll delivers consistent sativa effects in a portable, discreet package. Perfect for on-the-go cannabis enthusiasts seeking energetic, uplifting experiences.
